messages:
joan: Quick idea : Rooftop 'Bento & Succulent Swap' next Wed? Bring a packed lunch (bento, salad, sandwich) and a small plant to trade. BYO container for plant. :bento: :seedling:
raj: hah love it. what time? lunch slot or after work snack?
liz: lunchtime is better for me. also can we do a no-nut rule for the swap table?
amir: noon or 12:30 works. i can bring spare coffee and a couple of tiny pots if someone needs one. :coffee: :herb:
joan: good call on nuts, liz. let's ask folks to label ingredients. i'm thinking Wed Jun 19 12:30-13:30 on the rooftop. short swap window + hangout.
raj: 12:30 sounds great. i'll bring chopsticks and some extra bento boxes (for swapping food into).
facilities: @joan thanks for the heads up. Please confirm headcount by Friday so we can unlock rooftop gate. Maximum 30 people per rooftop event.
joan: noted! i'll add an RSVP. can someone make a tiny sign that says 'Bento & Succulent Swap  please label allergies'?
liz: i'll make a sign and laminate it. also i'll bring scissors and plant tape.
amir: poll: 12:30 or 13:00? react with :one: for 12:30, :two: for 13:00.
raj: :one:
joan: :one: (also adding a note about soil-free cuttings only to avoid invasive plants)
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Bento & Succulent Swap (Rooftop)"  Wed Jun 19 12:30-13:30  RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/succulent-swap-222
```
Invite: Bento & Succulent Swap
When: Wed Jun 19, 12:30-13:30
Where: Rooftop (Building A)
Notes: Label food for allergens. No soil-heavy plants, bring small pots or containers. RSVP by Fri Jun 14. Rooftop gate will be unlocked at 12:20. Max 30 people.
```
joan: i'll post a simple Google sheet later today for signups (food, plant, supplies). please add dietary labels.
liz: bringing a tiny packet of plant food and a care note template people can fill out.
amir: i'll bring four tiny pots and a handful of toothpicks for plant markers.
raj: anyone want to do a 5-min micro-talk on succulent care? i can do a quick 'how to not kill your jade' demo.
joan: raj you're on. thanks everyone! i'll ping again on Friday with the headcount reminder. :seedling::bento:
